--- title: "Hyperparameter Optimization with Optuna" description: "Use the HPO module to find optimal hyperparameters — warmstarting, per-model search spaces, Optuna pruners, and param importance tracking." date: today format: html: self-contained: true embed-resources: true code-fold: true code-tools: true --- Use the **HPO** module to find optimal hyperparameters for any model. Features demonstrated: - Warmstarting from previous experiment logs - Per-model search spaces - Optuna study creation with pruners - Param importance tracking ## 1. Prepare Data ::: {#prepare-hpo-data .cell cache='true' execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import polars as pl from sklearn.datasets import make_classification from tabular_blueprint.data.adapter import DataAdapter X_raw, y_raw = make_classification( n_samples=3000, n_features=20, n_informative=12, random_state=42 ) df = pl.DataFrame({f"f_{i}": X_raw[:, i] for i in range(X_raw.shape[1])}) df = df.with_columns(target=pl.Series(y_raw)) adapter = DataAdapter(target_format="numpy") X, y = adapter.transform(df, "target") print(f"X: {X.shape}, y: {y.shape}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` X: (3000, 20), y: (3000,) ``` ::: ::: ## 2. Create Optuna Study ::: {#create-study .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} from tabular_blueprint.engine.hpo import create_study study = create_study( model_name="catboost", direction="maximize", n_trials=30, pruner="hyperband", ) print(f"Study: {study.study_name} | Direction: {study.direction}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}

Run HPO for CatBoost ::: {#catboost-hpo .cell cache='true' execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} from tabular_blueprint.engine.hpo import optimize_model from tabular_blueprint.engine.evaluator import Evaluator from tabular_blueprint.config import ExperimentConfig from tabular_blueprint.models.factory import get_model_class eval_config = ExperimentConfig( name="hpo_nb", task="classification", target_col="target", data_path="", cv_folds=3, metrics=["roc_auc"], ) evaluator = Evaluator(eval_config) model_cls = get_model_class("catboost") hpo_result = optimize_model( model_cls, X, y, evaluator, "catboost", n_trials=20, task="classification", ) print(f"Best ROC AUC: {hpo_result['best_value']:.4f}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}

Warmstart from Previous Runs ::: {#warmstart-hpo .cell cache='true' execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} import tempfile from pathlib import Path from tabular_blueprint.engine.hpo import optimize_model as om3 from tabular_blueprint.engine.evaluator import Evaluator as Ev3 from tabular_blueprint.config import ExperimentConfig as Ec3 from tabular_blueprint.models.factory import get_model_class as Gc3 log_path = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "hpo_warmstart.jsonl" eval_cfg3 = Ec3( name="warm", task="classification", target_col="target", data_path="", cv_folds=3, metrics=["roc_auc"], ) ev3 = Ev3(eval_cfg3) xgb_cls = Gc3("xgboost") first_pass = om3( xgb_cls, X, y, ev3, "xgboost", n_trials=10, task="classification", log_path=str(log_path), ) warmstarted = om3( xgb_cls, X, y, ev3, "xgboost", n_trials=10, task="classification", log_path=str(log_path), ) print(f"First pass: {first_pass['best_value']:.4f} -> Warmstarted: {warmstarted['best_value']:.4f} | Warmstart trials: {warmstarted.get('warmstart_trials', 0)}") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}
